cd /private/var/folders/kp/vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn/T/barcode-mdb_e9kf; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-private-var-folders-kp-vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn-T-barcode-mdb-e9kf/d4b89da5-569d-4137-921b-409521809300/scratchpad/c.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np,subprocess
from PIL import Image
b=np.array(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)[100]
N=100
bs=np.array([b[int(i*len(b)/N):int((i+1)*len(b)/N)].mean(0) for i in range(N)])
for L in 'ABCDEFGHIJ':
    out=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','quiet','-i',f'videos/{L}.mp4','-vf','fps=2,scale=1:1','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-'],capture_output=True).stdout
    a=np.frombuffer(out,np.uint8).reshape(-1,3).astype(float)
    vs=np.array([a[int(i*len(a)/N):int((i+1)*len(a)/N)].mean(0) for i in range(N)])
    print(L,np.abs(vs-bs).mean())
EOF
